definitions.explanation: The total amount of money earned in a single month, typically referring to salary or wages before or after tax.

examples.japanese: {月収|げっしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{月収|げっしゅう}30{万円|まんえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}している→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I live on a monthly income of 300,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{月収|げっしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Since changing jobs, my monthly income has increased significantly, so I've been able to save money.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in discussions about salary, living expenses, and financial planning. Can refer to gross or net income depending on context. Often followed by a specific amount: {月収|げっしゅう}20{万円|まんえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月収|げっしゅう}〜⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧: monthly income of ~ ten-thousand yen
- ⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧{月収|げっしゅう}: take-home monthly income
- {月収|げっしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: monthly income goes up
- {月収|げっしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: monthly income goes down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧: annual income
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧: salary, pay (general)
- ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧: income (broader, includes all sources)
